newsitem.title: INDIA: Coca Cola India unit export earning at $83.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Coca Cola India unit export earning at $83.8 mln.

text.p: Coca Cola India, a unit of Coca Cola Co, said on Thursday it had exported goods worth $83.8 million since its inception four years ago.

The firm said in a statement that exports were driven by agro-commodities like green coffee, black pepper, sesame seed and black tea. It said it had exported glass bottles, plastic crates and trucks to overseas bottlers.

Germany was the single largest export destination in value terms, the statement said. It accounted for 30 per cent of Coca Cola India's exports followed by Italy at 23 percent and the Netherlands at 10 percent.
The statement said that green coffee was being exported to Japan where it was being used in the preparation of the Japanese unit's Georgia brand of canned, ready-to-drink coffee.
Black tea from India had also found a market in Japan where Coca Cola was using it to prepare its Ka Cha Ka Den brand of canned, ready-to-drink range of teas, the statement added.
